result:
Fixed `scenario.json` in place.

What changed: the request now reads "Set the priority to High for the issue with the Refund label group of the Mobile team." (condition c2 text updated to "of the Mobile team" to match). The reader was right that "from the Mobile team" could attach to "the issue" instead of the label group — under that parse, `i-mob-4` (a Mobile-team issue) could arguably meet the request, and the background records (also Mobile-team issues) could arguably pass c2. With "of the Mobile team" directly following "label group," the team scope unambiguously modifies the label, so no new hints were added.

What I kept: the seed and decoys are unchanged — `i-mob-4` meets c1 (attached group named "Refund") and fails only c2 (workspace-scoped, not the Mobile team's), while `i-mob-5`/`i-mob-6` (workspace "Bug" label) fail both c1 and c2. Under the corrected attachment these all hold, so the prior findings resolve with the wording fix alone.
